'''Echani wraidskin chestguards''' were items of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were made from the skin of [[wraid]]s and consisted of ribbed [[Color/Legends|black]] sleeves and waist attached to a red and white patterned central body that had a control panel of some kind mounted on it.
